objective: Locate the earliest tested native compression where pooled scalar transfer fails, and characterize the complete scalar obstruction subspace without fitting coefficients.
sourceDomain: Same committed RS079 vertex triples and matched-dependency lists; pooled order6x3-k3,4x5-k4,6x3-k4. All maps are canonical existing lineage maps.
procedure: Freeze each mode's pooled feature catalog, all rows, row basis and complete kernel basis using structure only. Also freeze per-carrier bases.
Commit all structural artifacts before replay.
Align pinned RS077 scalar codes and confirm the common 00/01/10 loss/draw/win gauge.
For every mode evaluate both-bit scalar consistency, all three fixed scalar characters, scalar image of the whole structural kernel, and the quotient dimension dim(y(V))-dim(y(ker F)).

Publish certificates for every failing mode and check all retained per-carrier lineage controls. Inspect the already-published two-dependency certificate uniformly across every declared mode, without using it to select a map.
interpretationGuards: Modes form a declared lineage audit, not an assumed totally ordered partition chain.
